answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The haven cap is policed at intake and gale reveals the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a opal tag. A farm of 55 pays that 220 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
